verdict.rationale: Extend ships a CLI, SDKs and a hosted platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The pack documents only data-retention and zero-data-retention controls for processed documents. Those are adjacent privacy features, not an opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
